new: Spaceships can loop: the right stick's up and down now turns the nose at a steady rate with no limit, so held back the ship goes round in a loop (about 2.6 s, about 1 m across). Forward still dives, back still climbs.
Let go of the stick the right way up and the ship eases back to level flight; let go upside down and it keeps flying upside down. Upside down, right still turns it to its own right.
The arena's floor and ceiling now bounce the ship back instead of holding it level.
No more black halo round the glows of ships, drones and pickups in AR: the glows now only add light over your room.
The main site has this release too.
test: Hold the stick back: does the ship loop smoothly, and does a loop fit in your room? Let go at different points of it.
Fly upside down and push the stick right: does it turn the way you expect?
In AR, look at the ship's engine, the drones' red eyes, the crystals and the pickups: any dark square or ring round them now?
untested: How loops feel on a Quest and whether 140 degrees a second is the right speed for them.
The glows over a real passthrough (checked only in a headless browser with a see-through background).
